machines.name: Shooter mode
machines.description: What the shooter is doing: off, pre-spinning in the alliance zone, or shooting while A is held (or the auto shoots).

states.name: Rev
states.description: In the alliance zone: the flywheel pre-spins for the hub shot.

states.name: Shooting
states.description: Spin up, then feed (ShotCycle). Hub shot in the alliance zone, corner feed elsewhere.

transitions.name: A released / outtaking
transitions.description: Inside the alliance zone it goes straight on to Rev.

inputs.name: Stop everything (auto ended, or test mode)

machines.name: Intake mode
machines.description: What the intake is doing. X toggles intaking, Y (held) jitters, B toggles the slide out with the rollers off, the left trigger (held) outtakes.

states.name: Jittering
states.description: Slide jitters to settle pieces, rollers in. Releasing Y goes back to intaking.

states.name: Outtaking
states.description: Rollers and feeder reverse; the shooter stops.

transitions.name: Disabled, stop all or auto stows

source.converted: Pose anchors from the legacy paths; existing marker bindings and mechanism behavior preserved. Executed by vendored Mayhem C++ suite runtime.
source.markerWarningsResolved: Legacy missing intake2/idle2 bindings replaced with explicit progress markers for each collection and stage-end. All marker actions now use exact autonomous intent.
source.stateRedesign: Intent-driven Mayhem supervisor, continuous shot/hood/slide/aim/trench interlocks, clean cancellation, explicit auto phase intent. Supersedes legacy zone and missing second-sweep marker behavior.
